acceptance_notes: Independently read all 222 actual source units in original order, all 198 retained source/target/rationale triples, all 24 source-only deferral explanations and four unretained candidate texts. A truncated early tool output was completed by explicitly rereading Ecclesiastes 2:20 through 3:8 triples.

Read the complete enumerated author context, including 208 context units not already present among the source, retained targets or candidate passages. All native continuations in these ranges were read.

Read the final amended triples at 1:17, 7:6, 7:18, 7:25, 8:10, 8:11, 10:10, 10:16, 12:9 and 12:10. The final 12:10 relationship label, related value of speech, was covered in the post-freeze chapter 11–12 reading. Native wording and actor limitations are preserved.

Same-chapter explanations identify actual literary development, repetition or contrast. Narrative comparisons are qualified rather than asserting common actors or direct quotation. Difficult or insufficiently supported units remain targetless pending source deferrals.
Semantic acceptance is separate from hashing, pin checks, rendering and any independent specialist or original-language review.
